title: Sunscreen: Consumer Reports Test Picks (2026)
desc: Ranked product picks transcribed from the named source. The order follows the source’s overall ranking or its labeled category winners; where picks cover different use cases, the list is not a single like-for-like score. Read each product note and source before choosing.

source.name: Consumer Reports 2026 sunscreen testing, reported by Quartz
source.note: All listed products, source labels, and supporting descriptions were checked against the linked article by AllRanks on 2026-10-20. For category-specific picks, the article’s order is retained; different formulas and use cases are not directly comparable.
